mentions.name: Tutor
mentions.description: Tutor is an open-source local AI study tool that extracts concepts from study materials (books, online documentation, and YouTube courses), generates lessons in simple language, and tests the learner. Users plug in whichever API provider they prefer with their own key; the author uses it with GPT Luna and Haiku.
mentions.problem: The author was laid off and needed to update their knowledge to pass interviews, but being a slow learner, needed to accelerate the learning process.
mentions.audience: Learners who need to study efficiently from books, documentation, and video courses, such as job seekers preparing for interviews.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Tutor, an open-source local project that extracts all the concepts (using AI) from study materials (I started with books and online documentation, but recently added YouTube courses as well), creates lessons in simple language, and also tests you.
mentions.author: edelind
